stages.oracle: A first-time visitor sees the native Jovie sign-in screen and can start browser authentication; unavailable and cancelled states offer recovery.
The canary completes browser PKCE authentication and the native token exchange returns the same signed-in user, never another account or fixture identity.
The canary completes required profile setup natively and its own handle and artist data appear in the app; a web-only detour or generic placeholder fails.
The native profile and library show the canary's own artist and releases; opening a release preserves identity and gives a working next action without errors or quota walls.
The canary's Settings billing handoff shows the canonical Artist Presence price, test-mode checkout completes, and the same account's paid entitlement is reflected after returning to the native app.

accounts.source: apps/web/lib/synthetic/prodcert-identities.ts; existing canary identities on the shared Jovie backend, with native browser PKCE and token exchange; fixture launches do not prove authentication

paidOutcome.freeAlternative: Jovie Free (profile, smart links, release pages and fan capture) or a free link-in-bio
